flash a smile: The shy waiter would flash a smile at every customer who came through the door of the café.
那位害羞的服務生會對每一位走進咖啡廳的客人露出微笑。
flash one's ID: The police officer had to flash his ID at the guard before he was allowed into the building.
警察必須向警衛亮出證件，才被允許進入大樓。
a thought flashed through my mind: Just as I locked the door, a thought flashed through my mind: had I turned off the stove?
就在我鎖門時，一個念頭閃過腦海：我有關瓦斯爐嗎？
flash back: Whenever I hear that old song, my mind will flash back to the summer I spent with Grandpa.
每當我聽到那首老歌，就會回想起和爺爺一起度過的那個夏天。
flash of inspiration: In a sudden flash of inspiration, the writer knew exactly how to end her new novel.
靈光一閃之下，作家清楚知道該如何為她的新小說收尾。
flatter oneself: He likes to flatter himself that he is the best singer in class, but nobody else agrees.
他喜歡自我陶醉，認為自己是班上最會唱歌的人，但沒有別人同意。
be flattered by: She was flattered by her teacher's kind words and blushed with a happy smile.
她因老師的讚美而受寵若驚，臉紅地露出開心的笑容。
the photo flatters him: The photo flatters him; in real life he looks much older and more tired than in the picture.
照片把他拍得比本人好看；現實中他看起來比照片裡老得多、也累得多。
flatter the boss: Tom always tries to flatter the boss by praising every idea he has, even the bad ones.
湯姆總是想奉承老闆，稱讚他的每一個點子，連爛點子也不例外。
flavor the soup: My grandma uses fresh herbs and a little salt to flavor the soup, and it always tastes wonderful.
奶奶用新鮮香草和一點鹽為湯調味，湯總是非常好喝。
flavored with lemon: This iced tea is lightly flavored with lemon, so it tastes fresh and just a little sour.
這杯冰茶帶有淡淡的檸檬口味，所以喝起來清爽，只有一點點酸。
local flavor: Visitors love the night market because it is full of local flavor, from street snacks to old games.
遊客喜愛夜市，因為那裡充滿地方特色，從街頭小吃到古早遊戲都有。
flavor of the month: That singer was the flavor of the month last year, but now hardly anyone remembers her songs.
那位歌手去年紅極一時，但如今幾乎沒人記得她的歌。
flee the country: The rich businessman tried to flee the country by boat after the police discovered his crimes.
警方發現他的罪行後，那位富商試圖搭船逃離國家。
flee from danger: When the forest fire spread, the animals began to flee from danger toward the river.
森林大火蔓延時，動物們開始朝河邊逃離危險。
flee in panic: When the earthquake shook the mall, shoppers began to flee in panic toward the exits.
地震搖晃購物中心時，購物者開始驚慌地往出口逃竄。
flee persecution: Many families had to flee persecution in their homeland and start new lives in another country.
許多家庭不得不逃避家鄉的迫害，在另一個國家展開新生活。
flip a coin: We couldn't decide which movie to watch, so we decided to flip a coin to choose one.
我們無法決定要看哪部電影，所以決定擲硬幣來選一部。
flip through a book: Before buying a novel, I like to flip through a book in the store to see if the story interests me.
買小說之前，我喜歡在書店裡翻閱一下書，看看故事是否吸引我。
flip out: Dad will flip out if he sees the big scratch on the side of his brand-new car.
如果爸爸看到他新車側邊那道大刮痕，他一定會抓狂。
flip the switch: When you enter the dark room, just flip the switch on the left and the lights will come on.
你走進那間暗房時，只要按下左邊的開關，燈就會亮。
flip a house: Their plan is to flip a house: buy an old one cheaply, repair it, and sell it for profit.
他們的計畫是炒房：便宜買下舊房子，整修後再賣出賺錢。
float an idea: At the meeting, I decided to float an idea about a school trip to see how others would react.
會議上，我決定試探性地提出校外教學的想法，看看別人的反應。
float a company: The owners plan to float a company on the stock market next year to raise more money.
老闆們計畫明年讓公司在股市上市，以籌措更多資金。
float a loan: The government plans to float a loan to raise money for building new railways across the island.
政府計畫發行貸款，籌錢在全島興建新鐵路。
prices float: In a free market, prices float up and down depending on how much people want to buy.
在自由市場中，價格會依照人們的購買需求上下浮動。
float on the water: Dead leaves float on the water of the quiet pond, moving slowly in the gentle wind.
枯葉漂浮在寧靜池塘的水面上，在微風中緩緩移動。
flock to the beach: On hot summer weekends, thousands of people flock to the beach to swim and escape the heat.
炎熱的夏季週末，成千上萬的人湧向海灘游泳消暑。
tourists flocked in: After the small town appeared in a popular movie, tourists flocked in from all over the world.
這座小鎮在一部熱門電影中出現後，觀光客從世界各地蜂擁而至。
birds of a feather flock together: All his friends love video games too; as people say, birds of a feather flock together.
他所有的朋友也都熱愛電玩；正如俗話說的，物以類聚。
